Hello La Petite Roots team,

I'm Janani, and I build websites for preschools in Chennai. I was looking at lapetiteroots.com this week. I went through your gallery — Pongal with the sugarcane and kolam, the 'Roots to whizzkid' Annual Day, the field trip in matching yellow — and wondered what your website would feel like if parents saw those moments first instead of three small circles.

So I rebuilt it, using your own photos and details. Here's how it looks today and how it could look, on a computer and on a phone:
A:
See it live: https://jananiporkodi.github.io/revamp/la-petite-roots/
Open it on your phone and scroll slowly. It opens on your Pongal celebration with the children and their teacher, then brings up the Annual Day stage, the whizzkid group and the field trip as framed photos, ending with a button to book a school visit.

Why this matters now: AI search. More and more people skip Google and simply ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Google's AI answers for “a play school in Velachery”. These assistants recommend the businesses whose websites clearly tell them who you are, where you are and what you offer. Right now lapetiteroots.com doesn't give these tools your business details in a form they can read, like most websites built a few years ago. Your new website is built for it: your details are written in the standard format AI tools read (schema.org), it has a clear question-and-answer section, and an llms.txt file made for AI assistants.

  • Ready for AI search: your programmes and age groups, timings, after-school activities and address and answers to common questions, written so ChatGPT, Gemini and Google's AI answers can read and recommend you

  • Call and WhatsApp buttons on every screen
  • Basic Google setup, so parents searching for play schools in Velachery in Velachery can find you
  • Two rounds of changes: new photos, prices, wording, anything you like
  • One month of free fixes after launch
  • Free hosting: no monthly server bill
  • Payment: half to start, half when the site goes live

Timeline: live in 7 days
